# AI vs Human Text Detector

**Problem:** Classify whether a text was written by a human or generated by AI.

**Dataset:** AI vs Human text dataset from Kaggle (columns: text, generated).

**Method:** TF-IDF features + Logistic Regression (scikit-learn).

**Result:** 97.7% accuracy on 4,000 test samples.

**Tools:** Python, pandas, scikit-learn, matplotlib.
